Elena CSM: FYI kicking off Aurelia Health onboarding — putting stakeholders / success criteria / 21d timeline here. Hi @Priya :wave: can you confirm the primary users and SSO timeline?
Priya (Aurelia Health): Thanks Elena. Primary users are data ops + support (10 ppl). SSO planned for week 2, need SCIM. We need HIPAA checklist completed.
Elena CSM: Noted on SCIM/HIPAA. Proposed 3-week milestones: Week 1: integration + routing tests; Week 2: SSO + security review; Week 3: UAT + go-live. Quick schedule below.
Elena CSM: ```
Mon Day1: Kickoff + access
Tue Day2-5: Integration & test
Day8: SSO enable
Day12: Security review
Day18-21: UAT & go/no-go
```
Sam SE: I'll own integration work and pair with Priya's infra. Need model catalog access and sample payloads.
Priya (Aurelia Health): I'll send SCIM metadata and sample payloads by EOD tomorrow.
Marcus Onboarding: I'll run the enablement sessions—proposed two 60m workshops (Admin + Dev). Recording + materials will be shared.
Diego Support: I'll shadow the Week 3 UAT and prepare runbook for escalation.
Kerry (Legal): We have a redline for the DPA; legal will need final review before SSO. I'll upload to the shared folder and tag the ticket.
Elena CSM: Risks: (1) SCIM delay -> push SSO -> affects adoption; (2) External vendor for data mapping may add 5d; (3) If HIPAA docs delayed, cannot start private deployment. Please flag any other blockers.
Priya (Aurelia Health): Vendor mapping could be longer. I'll try to compress timeline and confirm by EOD.
Sam SE: Blocking ask: can we get a test dataset (sanitized) and expected QPS for baseline perf?
Elena CSM: Action items:
- Priya: send SCIM + sample dataset (due: +1d)
- Sam: request model access + test creds (due: +2d)
- Marcus: schedule enablement sessions (due: +3d)
- Kerry: share DPA timeline (due: +4d)
- Diego: prep runbook (due: +10d)
I'll set up 30m weekly syncs Tue 9am PT, first one Day3. Thoughts?
Priya (Aurelia Health): Tue 9am PT works for our team.
Sam SE: lgtm
Marcus Onboarding: +1 — will add calendar invites and the workshop agenda.
onboard-bot: Meeting created: "Weekly Onboard Sync — Tue 09:00 PT" starting 4512345689.
Elena CSM: Thanks all. I'll post tracker link and invite after this thread. :thumbsup:
